definitions.explanation: Medicine taken to stop diarrhea. The everyday word used in pharmacies and at home, in contrast with the technical {止|し}{瀉|しゃ}{薬|やく}.

examples.japanese: {下痢止|げりど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。

examples.english: You should take antidiarrheal medicine with you when you travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疑|うたが}われる→疑う：01889_utagau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下痢止|げりど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If food poisoning is suspected, please consult a doctor rather than using antidiarrheal medicine on your own.

notes:
⟦{下痢|げり}→下痢：05382_geri⟧ (diarrhea) + {止|ど}め, the noun form of ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (to stop). The same 〜{止|ど}め pattern names many household remedies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下痢止|げりど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take antidiarrheal medicine
- {下痢止|げりど}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the medicine works
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下痢止|げりど}め: over-the-counter antidiarrheal medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧: painkiller — the same word-formation pattern
- ⟦{整腸|せいちょう}{剤|ざい}→整腸剤：22358_seichouzai⟧: intestinal regulator — settles the gut rather than stopping diarrhea outright
